headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Telangana Today / The Hindu
bullets_en: Student bodies call anti-SIR protest at Dharna Chowk on Oct 25.
YSRCP hails Supreme Court directions on Andhra Pradesh local body polls.
Delhi Police has sought 3-day custody extension of CJP leaders Das, Ranka.
SEM court reserves order on judicial custody of Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka.
Govt. closely monitoring rainfall situation, says Sengottaiyan.
bullets_ur: Tulba tanzeemon ne 25 Oct ko Dharna Chowk par anti-SIR ehtijaj ki call de di.
YSRCP ne Andhra Pradesh baldiati intikhabat par Supreme Court ke ehkamat ka khair-maqdam kiya.
Delhi Police ne CJP rehnuma Das aur Ranka ki custody mein 3 roza tausee maang li.
SEM court ne Saurav Das aur Ashutosh Ranka ki judicial custody par faisla mehfooz kar liya.
Sengottaiyan ka kehna hai ke hukumat barishon ki soorat-e-haal par qareebi nazar rakh rahi hai.
